acceptance.heading: Acceptance
acceptance.text:
- [ ] A candidate with no PRS row is reported `UNRATED` and cannot reach `READY`.
- [ ] A candidate whose PRS rating predates its last issue update is reported `STALE` with both timestamps.
- [ ] `marathon_plan.py` ranks by PRS rank (four-axis sum or `ovr`) when present; PDDA trio only as the gate.
- [ ] `marathon-drive.sh --dry-run` exists, dispatches nothing, and exits with the real driver's codes.
- [ ] Negative control: a planted bad rating (e.g. `sev` 5 on a crash) is flagged `DISAGREES`.
- [ ] `test/gh<N>-marathon-rating-pass.sh` pins the four passes with positive and negative controls; registered in `validate.sh`.

acceptance.heading: codex-authored
acceptance.text: Missing, stale, and contradictory ratings are reported, and an unrated candidate cannot reach READY.

acceptance.heading: codex-authored
acceptance.text: The planner ranks on the verified four-axis sum or override while retaining the PDDA risk gate.

acceptance.heading: codex-authored
acceptance.text: The driver dry run dispatches nothing, preserves the real driver's exit codes, and does not create a plan file.

acceptance.heading: codex-authored
acceptance.text: Each pass produces a verdict, exit code, and written artifact; READY requires all four passes to succeed.

acceptance.heading: codex-authored
acceptance.text: Positive and negative controls cover the four passes and are registered in validation.
